name: bonifacio-blog
description: A database-backed field notes blog for Bonifacio.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bonifacio/blog-server && npm run build --workspace @bonifacio/blog-web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @bonifacio/blog-server" "npm run dev --workspace @bonifacio/blog-web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @bonifacio/blog-server && npm run test --workspace @bonifacio/blog-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @bonifacio/blog-server && npm run typecheck --workspace @bonifacio/blog-web
